integrity: All tournaments through six alternatives are exhausted. The bipartisan set uses an exact Pfaffian maximal-lottery computation with rational Gaussian replay on every strict case; the minimal covering set uses direct covering-set enumeration with an independent iterative-algorithm replay.
scientific_limitations: The result is a complete finite classification only through the first known disparity order. The order-six disparity threshold itself is prior work, and no larger-order frequency formula is claimed.
title: Complete first disparity layer for the bipartisan and minimal covering sets
